SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT A.BUYER, A.INV_NO FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_INV_SEND A WHERE A.BUYER = 'KRTCTE0002' AND A.IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY A.BUYER, A.INV_NO ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 10
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT A.BUYER, A.INV_NO AS KEP_INV_NO, A.INV_SEQ AS KEP_INV_SEQ, B.PO_NO AS KEP_PO_NO, B.PO_SEQ AS KEP_PO_SEQ, A.STATUS, B.BUYER_ITEM_NO, B.DESCRIPTION, B.SPECIFICATION, B.UNIT_MEASURE, B.UNIT_PRICE, B.ITEM_QTY AS PO_QTY, B.ITEM_AMT AS PO_AMT, A.ITEM_QTY AS INV_QTY, B.UNIT_PRICE * A.ITEM_QTY AS INV_AMT, A.INV_DATE, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.ATTR_01) AS VENDOR_NAME, C.PO_REMARK AS REMARK, C.PURCHASER_ID AS ADD_USER_ID, C.PURCHASER_NAME AS ADD_USER_NAME, (SELECT D.TEXT1 FROM ICOMLUSR F, ICOMCOD2 D WHERE F.USER_ID = C.PURCHASER_ID AND D.TYPE = 'C001' AND D.CODE = F.DEPARTMENT AND D.COMPANY_CODE = F.COM_CODE) AS ADD_USER_DEPT_NAME FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_INV_SEND A , ICOMPODT B , ICOMPOHD C WHERE A.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND A.INV_NO = '$G_RS.INV_NO$'
AND B.BUYER = A.BUYER AND B.PO_NO = A.LEGACY_PO_NO AND B.PO_SEQ = A.LEGACY_PO_SEQ
AND C.BUYER = B.BUYER AND C.PO_NO = B.PO_NO
UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_INV_SEND A SET A.IF_FLAG = 'Y' , A.IF_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') , A.IF_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') WHERE A.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND A.INV_NO = '$G_RS.INV_NO$'
<![CDATA[ UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_INV_SEND A SET A.IF_FLAG = 'E' , A.IF_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') , A.IF_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') WHERE A.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND A.INV_NO = '$G_RS.INV_NO$'
